hero_title: Smart Disaster Coordination and Resource Optimization System
hero_desc: With AI and real-time location data, we deliver the right resources to the right people in need as quickly as possible during a disaster.
track_desc: By entering the 8-digit tracking code given to you, you can monitor the status of the aid team in real time.
track_forgot: I forgot / lost my tracking code
equipment_desc: We are in the field with the latest generation of hardware capable of operating even in the harshest conditions.
equip_drone_desc: High-resolution thermal cameras that detect life at night and in limited visibility conditions.
equip_seismic_desc: Sensitive acoustic sensor systems that detect even the smallest sound and vibration under the debris.
equip_sat_desc: Mobile satellite stations providing instant data transfer at points where connection is lost.
equip_wearable_desc: AR-supported helmets that track the vital signs and locations of field personnel in real-time.
rec_modal_desc: Access recent records by selecting the District where you created your request.
how_we_work_desc: Your national disaster coordinator, fully compliant with AFAD standards, powered by artificial intelligence and data mining.
feat_ai_desc: By analyzing under-debris signals and help requests with location-based algorithms, we direct the right personnel to the scene within seconds.
feat_opt_desc: Using our T-SQL based data processing engine, we distribute critical relief supplies (water, food, medical kits) dynamically and fairly based on demand intensity.
feat_track_desc: We monitor all field movements, logistics flows, and team statuses 24/7 through integrated dashboard panels with real-time heatmaps.
impact_desc: Real stories of the change we created in the field by combining technology and human power.
impact_p_1: In the Great Marmara Exercise and local operations, 5000+ relief packages reached priority areas identified by our system in just 2 hours.
impact_p_2: Thanks to location data and smart filtering systems, emergency help requests were delivered 40% faster to professional rescue teams active in the field.
impact_p_3: Through our system, 30,000 active volunteers were automatically assigned to the right tasks in seconds based on their competencies (first aid, logistics, technical support).
impact_p_4: In case of GSM line failures during disasters, uninterrupted data flow was ensured in 81 provinces through system-integrated mobile base stations and satellite terminals.
impact_p_5: Logistics tracking and digital assignment of 1,000+ fully equipped shelter units to those in need were successfully completed within 24 hours after the earthquake.
impact_p_6: Dispatch of mobile health teams and ambulances to critical areas with the highest demand was planned in seconds via the fastest routes through the system.
impact_p_7: Hayati aids were delivered to the most critical points via helicopter and UAV-supported smart logistics shipment to steep terrains where transportation was cut off.
impact_p_8: Field coordination and real-time case tracking of mobile psychosocial support units established for social recovery after disasters were managed through the system.
impact_p_9: Disaster awareness and preparedness of 100,000+ citizens were increased through large-scale disaster simulations and training programs planned through the system.
footer_desc: Disaster and Emergency Management Technologies | Smart City Coordination Infrastructure
